cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.12.4)

project(sysInfoPackageLinuxParserRPM_unit_test)

file(GLOB sysinfo_UNIT_TEST_SRC "*.cpp")

file(GLOB PARSER_SRC
     "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../src/packages/packageLinuxParserRpm.cpp")
file(GLOB RPM_SRC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../src/packages/rpm*.cpp")

add_executable(sysInfoPackageLinuxParserRPM_unit_test ${sysinfo_UNIT_TEST_SRC}
                                                      ${RPM_SRC} ${PARSER_SRC})

# Includes rpm headers generated by the rpm build; without this, a parallel build can compile it
# before rpm_external has produced them when the precompiled rpm library is unavailable.
if(TARGET rpm_external)
  add_dependencies(sysInfoPackageLinuxParserRPM_unit_test rpm_external)
endif()

set_property(TARGET sysInfoPackageLinuxParserRPM_unit_test
             PROPERTY COMPILE_FLAGS "-Wno-unused-parameter")
target_link_libraries(
  sysInfoPackageLinuxParserRPM_unit_test
  debug
  gtestd
  debug
  gmockd
  debug
  gtest_maind
  debug
  gmock_maind
  optimized
  gtest
  optimized
  gmock
  optimized
  gtest_main
  optimized
  gmock_main
  pthread
  dl
  FilesystemWrapper)

add_test(NAME sysInfoPackageLinuxParserRPM_unit_test
         COMMAND sysInfoPackageLinuxParserRPM_unit_test)

set_tests_properties(sysInfoPackageLinuxParserRPM_unit_test PROPERTIES LABELS "data_provider")
